page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.gn8v-tee.4xlarge is a GPU-accelerated server instance designed for workloads requiring dedicated parallel processing capabilities. It is powered by an Intel Xeon 8469C processor running at 2.6 GHz on the x86_64 architecture, delivering 16 dedicated virtual CPUs. The system is equipped with 96.0 GB of system memory, providing a ratio of 6.0 GB of RAM per virtual core.

This instance features a single graphics processing unit equipped with 96 GB of dedicated video RAM. It does not include any local storage, meaning all storage requirements must be met through external network-attached block storage. Network connectivity is supported by a baseline bandwidth of 12 Gbps, managed via a KVM hypervisor.

The combination of 16 dedicated vCPUs, 96 GB of system RAM, and a 96 GB VRAM GPU makes this instance suitable for memory-intensive GPU workloads, such as deep learning inference, medium-scale model training, and data-parallel analytics. The lack of local storage represents a design tradeoff, requiring users to factor in the latency of network-attached storage. From a cost-efficiency perspective, the high VRAM-to-system-RAM ratio provides a dense resource profile for GPU-bound tasks without the overhead of excess CPU cores.
